cause.enforcementGap: Exhaustive Module Truth existed, but its source/served-byte anti-regression checks were only executed on special preterminal/terminal triggers instead of being a mandatory prerequisite before every focal product materialization.
cause.historicalEffect: A focal fix could be source-correct while previously approved modules were not mechanically re-proven in the same run, allowing source/runtime/hosting/load-order/cache drift to surface later.

after.rule: Every focal product source must pass a cumulative no-regression source guard before any build/deploy, and every materialization must reprove all previously closed P0 contracts live before the new focal finding can close.
sourceGuard: exact diff from last accepted cumulative product source limited to declared owners
byte parity for previously closed-module owners
liveGuard: same fresh HR authority and counts remain valid
previously closed Postulaciones active/history contract remains valid
after.promotionRule: A newly proven source becomes the next cumulative baseline only after both source guard and live cumulative guard PASS.
